test_title: PYST 6: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:13 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

Minal said that they were boarding the train then.

options.text: Minal said, “We have been boarding the train now.”
Minal said, “We are boarding the train now.”
Minal asked, “Are we boarding the train now?”
Minal told, “We would be boarding the train by then.”

solution:
The correct answer is option (2). [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in indirect speech. 'Minal' is the speaker. Minal is talking about themselves.
 
• That's why in the direct speech 'they' will change into 'we'.
 
• When we convert indirect speech to direct speech the reported speech will come under a double inverted comma.
 
• After the reporting speech, there will be a comma and 'That' will be removed.
 
• **'then'** is changed into **'now'**.
 
• **"they were boarding the train then**" is in the past continuous tense. It will be changed into a present continuous tense "**We are boarding the train now**".

Therefore the correct direct speech is*** Minal said, “We are boarding the train now.” *** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• Let’s identify the reporting speech and reported speech.

 
 
• He said, “I go to school every day.”
 
• In the above sentence “He said” is the reporting speech.
 
• “I go to school every day.” is the reported speech.
